DIALOGUE_AUCTION_1.en: Welcome to the Auction House! Bid on items or put your own up for auction!

DIALOGUE_BLACKSMITH_1.en: Reforge your weapons, armor, and accessories here to boost your stats!

DIALOGUE_ELIZABETH_1.en: Welcome to the Community Center! Spend Bits or upgrade your profile perks here!

DIALOGUE_JERRY_1.en: Your SkyBlock island is part of a much larger universe.

DIALOGUE_JERRY_2.en: The SkyBlock universe is full of islands to explore and resources to discover!

DIALOGUE_KAT_1.en: Hi! I'm Kat, the Pet Sitter! I can upgrade the rarity of your pets!

DIALOGUE_MADDOX_2.zh_tw: 點擊開始一項殺手任務！

DIALOGUE_MORT_1.en: Welcome to the Catacombs! Ready to enter the dungeon?
